projectTitle: note-espidf: ESP-IDF component for Blues Notecard
description: ESP-IDF component (blues/notecard) for using a Blues Notecard from ESP32-series chips over I2C or UART. notecard_init() sets up the bus and registers the note-c library's platform hooks with FreeRTOS mutexes, after which applications call the note-c API. Pins, I2C address, baud rate, and logging are configured in menuconfig. Includes I2C and UART examples.
rules: Install with `idf.py add-dependency "blues/notecard"` and include "notecard.h", which also provides the note-c API (NoteNewRequest(), NoteRequest(), JAddStringToObject()).

Call notecard_init() with NOTECARD_I2C_CONFIG_DEFAULT() or NOTECARD_UART_CONFIG_DEFAULT() and check for ESP_OK before any request. It registers note-c's hooks; don't call NoteSetFn(), NoteSetFnI2C() or NoteSetFnSerial().
Set pins, I2C address, UART baud rate and logging in menuconfig under Component config > Notecard Configuration (CONFIG_NOTECARD_* symbols), or change notecard_config_t fields before notecard_init().
Set the ProductUID with CONFIG_NOTEHUB_PRODUCT_UID (sdkconfig.defaults or menuconfig) and pass it as the "product" argument of hub.set.
NoteRequest() and NoteRequestResponse() free the request; check each response with NoteResponseError() and free it with NoteDeleteResponse().
If other devices share the Notecard's I2C bus, wrap their transfers in notecard_i2c_lock() and notecard_i2c_unlock() (CONFIG_NOTECARD_I2C_MUTEX, enabled by default).
Copy Notecard request and argument names exactly from the Notecard API reference; do not invent requests, arguments, or response fields.
When the Blues Expert MCP server is connected, check generated Notecard JSON requests with its api_validate tool before using them.
